name: iFlight Mach R5 Sport class, 6S
notes: Class preset of a 5-inch race quad: iFlight's ready-to-fly racer, built like the MultiGP field (210 mm frame, 2207 motors of about 2000KV, 5.1-inch race props, 6S 1300-1400 mAh; docs/research/drones-v08.md). Weights, geometry, motors, props and battery from iFlight's listing; thrust, inertia, motor lag and aerodynamics are estimates. Nothing here is endorsed by iFlight.

battery.note: the pack of iFlight's take-off weight and hover time; top racers favour 6S 1050-1300 mAh high-C packs

auw_g.note: take-off weight with the 6S 1400 mAh pack (HDZero version listing)

twr.note: a 2207 of about 2000KV pulls 1.85-2.1 kg on a 5-inch prop at 6S on a stand (miniquadtestbench, maker benches): x4 / 525 g = about 15 static, about 12.5 under a loaded 6S pack in flight

inertia_roll_pitch_kgm2.note: sum of parts: motors and props at the arm ends, light race frame, pack on top

motor_tau_ms.note: J / (Kt^2/R + 2 Q0/w0) for a 2207 2050KV with a 4.2 g prop: about 14 ms

motor_kappa_m.note: reaction torque / thrust of a 5.1x3.8 tri-blade

rpm_loaded_fraction.note: loaded rpm / (KV * V), only used for battery current

cda_vertical_cm2.note: set so the top speed in the simulator is about 180 km/h (iFlight states 208 km/h; GPS logs of 6S racers are mostly 150-180 km/h); stands in for the props unloading at speed, which the model does not have

collider_duct_radius_mm.note: open props: one sphere per prop zone

collider_duct_offset_mm.note: reaches the prop tips (arm 74 mm + prop radius 65 mm)

v_crash_ms.note: race frames are built to take gate hits

pack_resistance_per_cell_ohm.note: high-C 6S race pack, wiring and XT60 included

flight_time.value: about 12 min hover (iFlight); 1.5-3 min of racing
flight_time.note: race laps: miniquadtestbench (Five33 2207) 1:30 at full throttle, 2 min and more at reduced throttle

camera_uptilt_deg.note: racers fly with a high camera angle, about 30-45 deg

camera_fov_deg.note: horizontal field of view of the simulated camera

rates.note: Betaflight 4.5 defaults; racers usually fly their own (paste your diff all)

pid_roll.note: P, I, D, F; Betaflight's default tune is made on 5-inch quads

rotor_drag_per_s.note: momentum theory sqrt(g rho A_rotors / m) = 1.08 1/s times 0.55, the share Faessler et al. 2018 measured on an open-prop quad (0.24-0.54 1/s on a heavier one)

rotor_inertia_kgm2.note: 4.2 g prop (about 0.2 m R^2) + 2207 bell (about 14 g at 11 mm)

wake_loss.note: share of thrust lost at the worst point of a descent through the rotors' own wake (vortex-ring band of momentum theory); sim-core wake.ts

wake_shake.note: turbulent roll/pitch torque in the wake, as a share of one rotor's thrust times the arm (rotor thrust fluctuates by tens of per cent in the vortex-ring state)
